subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Vocabulary e.g. clothing, colours, boots, dress, pants, skirt, uniform, jersey, T-shirt, choose, buy, shopping, mirror

show.line: What do you wear? A dress, boots, a jersey, a shirt. Let's learn clothes!

rounds.praise: Yes! Boots go on our feet.

rounds.prompt: It is cold. What do we wear?

rounds.story: Neo buys two red shirts at the shop. What does Neo buy?

rounds.prompt: Do we wear it on our feet or on our body? Sort the pictures.

hints: Look at the picture. Where do we wear it?
Boots and socks go on our feet.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It is a jersey. We wear it when it is cold.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. A jersey keeps us warm!

parent_line: Can name clothes in English: dress, boots, jersey, shirt, socks.
